setup: CREATE TABLE data (id integer, n numeric(8,2), d date, ts timestamp, tz timestamptz, b boolean, s text)

cases.sql: SELECT * FROM data ORDER BY id NULLS FIRST
SELECT id FROM data WHERE false
SELECT sum(id), min(id), max(id) FROM data
SELECT id, count(*) FROM data GROUP BY id ORDER BY id
WITH c AS (SELECT id FROM data) SELECT * FROM c
SELECT id FROM data UNION SELECT id FROM data
SELECT CASE WHEN b THEN s ELSE 'no' END FROM data
SELECT CAST('NaN' AS double precision), CAST('Infinity' AS double precision)
